out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Refuse Areas & Enclosures Maintained Clean
violations.observation: Observed the enclosed area around the dumpster had trash throughout.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the dumpster enclosure free of trash. CFM instructed staff to clean the area. Olive Garden Italian Restaurant 1462 (Inspection Date: 06/24/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the quaternary ammonium solution was measured at >400 ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of quaternary ammonium solution at 200-400ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit before placing on line for use. CFM will contact sanitizer company to verify proper concentration is dispensed. Until repair, CFM will check concentration and adjust accordingly before placing sanitizer buckets on line.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 3 DR UC Bar (#12), DELFIELD 1 DR UC (#13).
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. CFM provided thermometers for units.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: squeeze bottles of sauces, oils at cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM had employee label bottles.

violations.title: Equipment Clean to Sight and Touch
violations.observation: Observed accumulation of juice/beverage drippings on bottom of 3 DR UC (#12) bar refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Clean and sanitize interior of bar refrigeration units. Olive Garden Italian Restaurant 1462 (Inspection Date: 05/15/2025) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed surfaces of bar area, underneath mats, are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. CFM will have bar area thoroughly cleaned.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, not all employees have received training on the employee health policy. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment and all employees must be trained on the policy. New employees hired since August do not have documentation of training in the training log,
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). All employees must be informed of their responsibility to report certain illnesses, symptoms and exposures to their manager. Ensure all employees have received this training and maintain record of employee training for health department review.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The following handwashing sinks were not providing hot water at 100F: sink by soup line:90F, Women’s employee restroom: 44F, men’s employee restroom: 91F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the ROP station being used to rinse equipment.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: Steak Gorgonzola Alfredo on the specials menu, 6oz sirloin on the allergen menu.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. Menu items should be identified with an asterisk and linked to a statement that outlines risk of consumption.

out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: Compliance with Variance and HACCP Plan
violations.observation: The permit holder is not in compliance with the HACCP plans and procedures that were submitted as specified in 8-201.14 and approved as a basis for the modification or waiver. Observed no cooling temperatures documented for marinara and pasta fagioli on 1/9/25. Observed final cooling temp for Alfredo taken after 7.25 hours and chicken and gnocchi final temperature taken after 7.3 hours on 1/8/25.
violations.corrective_action: An operation with an approved HACCP plan must comply with procedures within their plan. Train staff on proper documentation of cooling times and temperatures per your plan.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: calamari thawing at the the three compartment sink under running water was observed at 47F. Employee stated it had been thawing for one hour.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. NOTE: reduce thawing time so that temperatures don’t exceed 41F.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed utensils stored in warm water (97F) by the oven range.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. NOTE: water replaced with water at 211F.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment Components, Adjusted per Manufacturer
violations.observation: The door gaskets of the following units are torn: 1-door reach in freezer, 2-door reach in refrigerator. The cap on the nozzle of the fire suppression system was out of place. (Corrected during the inspection) Observed water dripping from a plumbing component on the soda machine system.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment components such as doors, seals, hinges, fasteners, and kick plates shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted in accordance with manufacturer's specifications. Replace the torn gaskets. Maintain caps in place on fire suppression system nozzles at the hood. Repair the soda machine so that it no longer drips.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip or equipment available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The hand sink in the women’s employee restroom provides only a slow trickle of water.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Repair the sink so that it provides adequate water for handwashing.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the ladies room handicap stall.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Refuse Areas & Enclosures Maintained Clean
violations.observation: Trash and litter were observed adjacent to the refuse container outside the facility.
violations.corrective_action: A storage area and enclosure for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be maintained free of unnecessary items and kept clean. Olive Garden Italian Restaurant 1462 (Inspection Date: 01/10/2025) Page 3 of 4

violations.title: Outside Receptacle, Tight Fitting Lids
violations.corrective_action: Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered with tight fitting lids or doors if kept outside the food establishment.
